path.description: One workspace-relative file or directory, or . for the root; use exactly one of path or paths.

paths.description: Up to 20 workspace-relative files or directories, searched in order; use exactly one of path or paths.

query.description: Single-line query: a literal string, or a pattern when regex is true.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression. Defaults to false.

max_results.description: Maximum matching lines. Defaults to as many as fit.
